title: Chicken with Red Pepper Romesco
summary: Juicy pan-seared chicken served with a smoky romesco-style sauce made from roasted red peppers, almonds, garlic and tomato. It’s rich, tangy and ideal for a comforting Spanish-style dinner.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Put the red peppers on a tray, drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, and roast for 20 minutes until softened and blistered. Let them cool slightly, then peel off any loose skin and remove the seeds.
While the peppers roast, toast the almonds in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and fragrant. Set aside.

Blend the roasted peppers, toasted almonds, garlic, canned tomatoes, red wine vinegar, paprika, 2 tbsp olive oil, water, 1 tsp salt and the black pepper until smooth or slightly textured, as you like. Taste and adjust seasoning.

Season the chicken thighs with the remaining salt. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until well browned and cooked through.
Spoon the romesco sauce into the pan or serve it alongside, then warm gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Scatter over the parsley and serve hot with potatoes, rice or bread if you like.
